😴 Most Viewed — Sleep Support

Why Your Neurodivergent Child Cannot Sleep — And What Actually Helps

It is not the screens. For ADHD and autistic children, sleep problems are rooted in how the neurodivergent brain produces melatonin — and in what they ate for dinner. Understanding this changes everything.

🧠
Melatonin is delayedADHD brains produce melatonin 1.5 to 2 hours later than neurotypical brains. This is biology — not a bedtime habit problem.
🍽️
Dinner affects sleepA high-carb dinner causes a blood sugar crash that releases cortisol at bedtime — the exact opposite of what a child needs to wind down.
🌙
Sensory wind-down worksA predictable sensory routine — dim lights, warm bath, consistent ritual — tells the nervous system it is finally safe to rest.

🍽️ Most Viewed — Sensory Food Issues

Why Mealtimes Are So Hard — The Sensory Food Truth

Sensory food refusal is not fussiness. For neurodivergent children, food involves texture, smell, temperature, colour and sound all at once. Every mealtime is a sensory negotiation.

👃
Sensory processing is realWhat smells fine to you can be overwhelming to a child with heightened sensory sensitivity. This is neurological — not picky eating.
🎨
Colour and texture matterA green fleck in food, a mixed texture, or an unexpected crunch can make eating impossible for a sensory-sensitive child.
🔄
Safe foods exist for a reasonSafe foods provide predictability. Work with them first — then expand gradually using food chaining strategies.

The missing piece

The answer was in the food and the routine all along.

🧠
Blood Sugar and the Brain
Blood sugar crashes release cortisol — the stress hormone. For neurodivergent children this creates meltdowns, poor focus and emotional dysregulation. Protein-anchored meals prevent this.
🍽️
Sensory-Friendly Meals
Meals designed around your child's sensory profile — safe textures, predictable presentation, familiar colours. Food that their nervous system can actually accept.
📅
Predictable Routines
Consistent routines reduce the number of decisions the neurodivergent nervous system must make — freeing up regulatory capacity for the real challenges of the day.
💚
Personal Coaching Support
One-to-one guidance built around your specific child — their sensory profile, their schedule, their challenges. Not generic advice. Your family.

Our story

Every child deserves
calm days.

Jane Wambui Njuguna
Neurodivergent Family Wellness Consultant 🌿

Hi, I am Jane 👋
Founder of Calm & Connect

I know what it feels like to watch your child struggle and feel completely helpless about what to do. The meltdowns. The refused meals. The sleepless nights. The school calls. The mornings that feel like battles before the day has even started.

"You are not failing. You are navigating something genuinely hard — and you deserve real support, not generic advice."

My search for answers led me to the connection between food, nervous system regulation and neurodivergent behaviour. When I understood that blood sugar, sensory processing and predictable routines were at the root of so much of what families were struggling with — everything changed.

I created Calm & Connect to make that knowledge practical, accessible and genuinely useful for real families around the world — regardless of where you live or what is in your kitchen.
